title: checklist runner kit: v18.5.0 sweep runner-environment facts in RUNNER.md and two scripts/qa fixture gaps
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQTVjryTSkqydKVS6z

Carries the runner-kit rows of #33761 (the v18.5.0 release test sweep anchor); #33761 keeps the item-text batches and the coverage card. Filing gate ①: the follow-up owed by in-flight work. Ledger: anchor comment 6896511848 (read at `origin/main` `895783a1`). Precedent: #33334 for the 18.4.0 sweep. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Scope

- Rows of ledger 6896511848: 7, 10, 22, 91, 103, 192, 202, 215. Rows 22 and 192 are runner facts, not item text (the seat's call on the ledger's open question).
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`: the runner-environment facts those rows name (for example row 10: the batched non-TTY reporter prints no per-file summary line, so a clause asking for "the summary line per pin file" needs `--reporter=verbose`).
- `scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs`: row 7, `FIXTURE --help` runs the fixture because `parseArgs` treats `--help` as a flag (no help branch); and the local OIDC stub fixture gap the ledger names.
- Every row re-read at `origin/main` first. ⛔ No `areas/*.json` item text (the batch cards carry it).

## Acceptance

- Each row is fixed or answered on the PR with a reading.
- `qa-fixture.mjs --help` prints usage and exits 0 without running a fixture; its self-test (if any) covers it.

Priority p2 (runner tooling; the 18.4.0 precedent #33334 was p2).
